rule: For airline-controlled cancellations, travelers may be rebooked on the next available eligible flight without a change fee.
Hotel accommodation may be considered for qualifying airline-controlled overnight disruptions, subject to eligibility.
Alternate airports may be proposed when they are reasonably reachable and materially improve recovery.
The agent must never charge a card, issue a refund, or accept a fare increase without explicit traveler approval.
Escalate when no viable recovery exists, when repeated tool failures occur, or when the request involves disputes, exceptions, safety, or identity concerns.
